source_qualifications_and_holds.finding: All four special interfaces cite B.3 (generic module) although Appendix B.4–B.7 label respective specialized files. Preserve uncorrected rule references; no native schema verified.

locators: §6.2.8.3 PDF111 Rule 6.2.8.3-1 (descriptive), Rule 6.2.8.3-2 (descriptive), and the later identically numbered normative shall Rules
source_qualifications_and_holds.finding: Two source-labeled descriptive paragraphs precede duplicate-numbered shall Rules 1 and 2. Preserve four original appearances with distinct evidence IDs, do not collapse.
Not all PICs implement in-band management; some PICs are indirectly represented on another PIC. No universal physically built-in management endpoint or installed-device inference.

Chassis Manager V1.0 low-level executeCommand passes IPMI messages to out-of-band management; source says access may be restricted. This is not a generic CSAPI physical command or unrestricted control authorization.
Native OpenAPI JSON files of four specialized interfaces not opened or parsed; displayed table objects and V1.0 labels are not schema/path or runtime tests.
Source notes do not publish full function/interactions mapping; do not generate native semantic join solely from matching names.
